title: Dinner Swapped for Water
hook: What if you skip dinner and drink only water?
banner:
WHAT IF YOU SKIP
ONLY WATER

beats.line: Your body shifts to burning stored fat for fuel.
beats.idea: A close‑up of a glucose meter needle falling as the character trembles.

beats.line: Your basal metabolism dips, conserving calories.
beats.idea: Cartoon fat cells shrink and melt away while a fire icon lights up inside the belly.

beats.line: Your stomach empties, reducing hunger signals.
beats.idea: A heart icon slows its beat and a thermostat dial turns down.

beats.line: Brain fog sets in, you feel mildly drunk.
beats.idea: The character’s stomach balloon deflates, and a sigh of relief appears.

beats.line: Blood sugar drops, you feel shaky.
beats.idea: A brain clouded with mist and wobbling eyes, a tiny cocktail glass icon fades in.

description: A quick look at how your body reacts when you replace dinner with water.

end.line: Would you swap dinner for water?

topic: What happens if you replace dinner with water?
